name: Song of The Wind
source:
Luna can’t speak. She pours her heart through music and writing to her beloved ones. Will she be able to show her feelings to a dear friend? How will she comfort her mother who was in the midst of fear and regrets? Follow her story on Song of the Wind.

[From [url=https://khiaramoon.itch.io/song-of-the-wind-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
露娜无法说话。她通过音乐与文字，向所爱的人倾诉内心。她能向珍视的朋友表达感情吗？又该如何安慰陷于恐惧与悔恨的母亲？在《Song of the Wind》中，跟随她的故事。

[摘自[url=https://khiaramoon.itch.io/song-of-the-wind-vn]itch.io[/url]]
